subject: In-flight keyflow, HSM rotation artifacts & wipe proofs — request from Clearline SecOps
messages:
From: security@clearline.com
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: in-flight keyflow diagrams + HSM rotation artifacts for SIG review

Hi Ben,

We're pulling together answers for the SIG questionnaire and need detailed artifacts covering encryption in-transit and key lifecycle. Specifically we need: 

- A network keyflow diagram showing where TLS and IPsec are used between customer clients, edge proxies, and inference hosts (call out ephemeral key usage).
- Proof that inter-region replication and control-plane traffic is TLS 1.3 (or later) and that perfect forward secrecy is enabled.
- HSM attestation or vendor-signed statement covering key custody for the last 12 months.
- A sample of key rotation logs that show KEK/DEK rotation events and operator approvals (suitably redacted).
- Evidence of secure key-wipe procedures when a tenant is deprovisioned (summary and checksums).

Can you provide these artifacts (PDF/CSV) or point us to a secure link? Also note any exceptions (BYOK tenants, customer-managed KEK). We have a 5-business-day turnaround for the SIG review.

Thanks,
Alex M.
Security Engineer — Clearline Financial
security@clearline.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2024 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: in-flight keyflow diagrams + HSM rotation artifacts for SIG review

Team — forwarding Clearline's ask (below). Target: package a short artifact bundle and a one-page narrative for SIG intake. Quick responsibilities: 

- Irene: pull HSM attestation (latest vendor statement) and a brief description of our custody controls; attach hsm_attestation_2024-04-10.pdf and include redaction note if needed.
- Jonas: produce an updated keyflow diagram that highlights TLS vs IPsec and calls out ephemeral key derivation (use keyflow_ipsec_tls_diagram_v2.pdf).
- Marissa: export a small rotation sample (rotation_sample_2024.csv) and the deprovision wipe checksum log (s3_transfer_checksums.txt). Mark any BYOK tenants and their exception notes.

Keep the bundle concise — Clearline wants artifacts for SIG not a full runbook. I'll be the point of contact; I'll send the package to security@clearline.com and CC auditor@secureq.io. If anything is sensitive, flag me and we'll use the secure drive link.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Apr 2024 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: in-flight keyflow diagrams + HSM rotation artifacts for SIG review

Ben — attaching the HSM attestation PDF and a short note on custody.

Notes:
- hsm_attestation_2024-04-10.pdf is the vendor-signed attestation for our HSM cluster (vendor: SafeHSM Inc.). It covers firmware levels and seal status as of 2024-04-10.
- We do not export raw key material; we provide wrapped key envelopes and rotation metadata.
- rotation_sample_2024.csv contains event timestamps, operator id hashes, and rotation type (scheduled / emergency). We've redacted operator emails to hashes per our data handling policy.
- kek_wrap_proof.txt contains a signed nonce showing KEK wrapping events; this is a short machine-readable stub auditors often request.

Caveats: BYOK tenants (3 total) have customer-owned KEK; those tenants are listed in the attached spreadsheet but with only the tenant id and status.

Attachments: hsm_attestation_2024-04-10.pdf (pdf), kek_wrap_proof.txt (txt), rotation_sample_2024.csv (csv)

Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Cryptography Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: security@clearline.com
Cc: auditor@secureq.io, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2024 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: in-flight keyflow diagrams + HSM rotation artifacts for SIG review

Hi Alex (and Clearline SecOps),

Thanks for the list — attached is a compact artifact bundle for the SIG review. Summary below and attachments are in the secure drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleSharedDriveLink

Summary (attachments included):
- keyflow_ipsec_tls_diagram_v2.pdf — visual diagram that marks client ↔ edge TLS 1.3 with PFS enabled, edge ↔ runtime control-plane over mTLS/TLS 1.3, and optional IPsec tunnels used for dedicated VPC peering. Ephemeral session keys are derived with HKDF per connection; diagram calls out where KV caches store wrapped DEKs.
- hsm_attestation_2024-04-10.pdf — vendor-signed attestation for our HSM fleet (SafeHSM Inc.) covering firmware and seal state.
- rotation_sample_2024.csv — sample rotation events for non-BYOK tenants (timestamps, rotation type, operator id hashes).
- kek_wrap_proof.txt — signed nonce showing wrap/unwrap events for KEK changes (machine-readable short proof).
- s3_transfer_checksums.txt — artifact demonstrating wipes/checksums used during tenant deprovisioning (redacted identifiers).

Important notes:
- Inter-region replication and control-plane communication use TLS 1.3 with cipher suites that provide forward secrecy.
- BYOK tenants retain their own KEKs; we wrap customer DEKs with the customer KEK and do not possess plaintext KEKs for those tenants. BYOK tenants are noted in the spreadsheet; if you want per-tenant artifact sharing, request a secure transfer for each tenant.
- For auditors: we've included a small CSV sample rather than the full log set; full extracts require an executed NDA/secure transfer.

Please confirm if this bundle satisfies Clearline's SIG intake. If you need additional sample rows or an HSM attestation chain, we can provide under a secure upload.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: keyflow_ipsec_tls_diagram_v2.pdf (pdf), hsm_attestation_2024-04-10.pdf (pdf), rotation_sample_2024.csv (csv), kek_wrap_proof.txt (txt), s3_transfer_checksums.txt (txt)
From: security@clearline.com
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: auditor@secureq.io
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2024 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: in-flight keyflow diagrams + HSM rotation artifacts for SIG review

Ben — got the package, thank you. Quick follow-ups: 

1) Can you confirm that inter-region replication traffic uses TLS 1.3 (not TLS 1.2) and that PFS is enforced in your configuration management?
2) For the BYOK tenants you flagged: do you perform KEK-wrapping with customer-provided KEKs or do customers supply wrapped KEKs at onboarding?

If you can answer these two items in a short reply we'll close this request for SIG intake.

Thanks,
Alex M.
Security Engineer — Clearline Financial
